members.name: varA
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent does the message express? Pick the single most specific intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: Customer wants to activate their (new) card or cannot activate it.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open/use an account; whether children/teens can have accounts.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or Android Pay with the account, including topping up via Apple Pay/Google Pay or it not working.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs the card works at; whether an ATM will take the card; finding an ATM; using ATMs abroad.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up feature: what it is, setting it up, turning it off, its limits or amounts.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money the customer transferred into their own account by bank transfer has not shown up in their balance; balance unchanged after a transfer. Includes transfers from their UK account: 'How long does a transfer from a UK account take? I made one and it isn't showing up', 'please check my UK account, I made the transfer a couple of hours ago'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Customer deposited money, a cheque or cash and it hasn't shown in their balance; 'I deposited money but it isn't showing', 'when will my deposit show up?'.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee; trouble transferring money to a beneficiary; a transfer to an account/beneficiary 'wasn't allowed' / is not allowed.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer/transaction they made (e.g. sent to wrong account).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; whether merchants/shops accept it; card not accepted at a merchant.
criteria.card_arrival: Customer ordered a card and it has not arrived yet; tracking a card in the post; card is late.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes in general, delivery times to a country, express delivery; when to expect a card (asked before/without a delay).
criteria.card_linking: Linking/adding a card to the app or account; making a card that arrived show in the app; re-linking a found card.
criteria.card_not_working: Physical card generally not working / not functioning, without being about a specific declined payment, ATM, contactless or virtual card.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Charged a fee for paying by card; charged extra when using the card; complaints about a 'hidden fee', 'too many fees', 'some of my payments have fees', 'I'm tired of being charged fees, when do you charge fees?'.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or purchase on the account that the customer says they didn't make, don't recognise, or is wrong (worded as a 'payment' or 'purchase', e.g. 'a payment on my statement is wrong').
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong or erroneous exchange rate charged on a card payment/purchase; complaint that the rate charged was wrong.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Charged a fee for an ATM cash withdrawal; withdrawal fees.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer didn't make / doesn't recognise, even if they suspect their card was copied; 'the app shows cash I did not receive/take out'.
criteria.change_pin: How to change or reset the PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: Customer says their card details were stolen, copied or compromised and someone may be using them for purchases. (An unrecognised cash withdrawal is cash_withdrawal_not_recognised instead.)
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service/account/card is available in; using the service while living in or moving to another country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: The customer's card or card payment was declined / rejected / didn't go through when buying something in a shop, restaurant or online.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM declined the cash withdrawal; could not withdraw cash.
criteria.declined_transfer: The customer's transfers are being declined or denied (the message says transfers are declined/denied, even if it also mentions a card purchase).
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer doesn't recognise; also vague 'unknown charge', 'unauthorised charge', 'I don't know what this charge is', 'how do I dispute a charge/debit' messages.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions on disposable virtual cards: how many uses, how many disposable cards can be made (e.g. per day).
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone, email, other information.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees/charges for exchanging currency; extra charges on currency exchange.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used; where the exchange rates come from; current rates.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange / convert money between currencies in the app (asking how to do it, or whether the app can do a specific conversion).
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: Extra charges on the statement: a small unexplained extra charge of about £1/$1/€1 (one pound/dollar/euro), even if pending or not recognised; 'what are these extra charges on my statement?'.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed / keeps failing / did not go through / was returned (worded as failing rather than declined).
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Whether a particular currency (EUR, USD, etc.) is supported or allowed for holding or exchange, e.g. 'Are EUR exchanges allowed?', 'Are you able to make exchanges to EUR?'; which fiat currencies are supported.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable virtual card; security options for everyday card purchases (a disposable card protects the customer).
criteria.get_physical_card: About the PIN for the customer's card: hasn't received the PIN yet, can't find the PIN, where is my PIN, how do I get or set a PIN for my (physical) card.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/spare/second card, or a card for a family member.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or order a (non-disposable) virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card was lost or stolen; customer wants help retrieving or finding their card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone was lost or stolen; access to app without phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Wants a physical (actual, plastic) card: how to get or order one, whether it is free/costs, where it can be delivered/shipped.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot passcode/password for the app; reset app passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment or purchase is pending / hasn't gone through yet; 'I have a payment that has not gone through yet' (worded as a payment, not a transfer).
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal shows as pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending / still processing.
criteria.pending_transfer: The customer's transfer shows as pending / still in progress / hasn't gone through yet, or a complaint about waiting a long time for a transfer to complete (even without the word 'pending').
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after wrong attempts; card/account blocked due to wrong PIN; unblock PIN.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money/payments from others; getting paid or receiving salary into the account (incl. 'do I need to add my salary?', being paid in a given currency).
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund from a merchant has not shown up in the account yet.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to request a refund for a purchase; how to get a refund.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted/returned/cancelled after being made: the seller says the money didn't go through, it was deducted then came back, or 'I paid for something but now I don't see it'.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, credit cards) and currencies are supported for top-ups or payments, including 'why doesn't my American Express work for adding money?'.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up specifically by bank transfer (the message mentions a bank transfer / SEPA / wire top-up).
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up / adding money with a card, e.g. 'is there a fee for topping up by card?', 'do you charge a fee for adding money in USD?'.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up / depositing with cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined or didn't work (including a card top-up that didn't work); 'not sure if my top-up went through'.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum/minimum top-up amounts, how much can be topped up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted/cancelled/returned, or the customer's top-up attempt (e.g. crypto top-up, 3D secure) didn't work and they don't know what happened to the money.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Topping up the account with a card: how to do it, which card, or a card top-up after which the money is gone.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment/transaction was charged twice; duplicate charge.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer; fees for banking/sending money abroad or an increase in fees overseas; short vague questions like 'why was I charged?' or 'will I get extra charges?'.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into/top up the account from another bank account.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Customer sent/transferred money to another person, business or account (friend, son, landlord, retailer; 'the account number is right') and it has not arrived / is 'not here yet'.
criteria.transfer_timing: General questions about how long transfers take to arrive, e.g. 'How long does a transfer from Europe/the US take?', 'when will my transfer reach my account?'.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Customer tried to verify their identity and it failed, is not working or still shows unverified ('my app says I'm not verified'); they can't do it (rejected, error, app won't accept documents).
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity / complete the identity checks; what documents are needed; customer is unsure how to do the verification process.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or showing the source of funds / where money comes from; questions about how the customer's money is checked or protected.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up / card used for top-up; verification code for a top-up; 3D secure for top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Virtual card is not working, or whether the virtual card can be used for certain transactions (e.g. memberships, subscriptions).
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard ('do you accept Visa or Mastercard?'); wanting a Visa card or a Mastercard specifically; choosing the card network.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is required; why personal info is requested; whether the customer can use the account without verifying or before verification has gone through.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong/less amount of cash than requested.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad.

criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after wrong attempts; card/account blocked due to wrong PIN; unblock PIN.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, credit cards) and currencies are supported for top-ups or payments, including 'why doesn't my American Express work for adding money?'.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up specifically by bank transfer (the message mentions a bank transfer / SEPA / wire top-up).
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable virtual card; security options for everyday card purchases (a disposable card protects the customer).
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund from a merchant has not shown up in the account yet.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or order a (non-disposable) virtual card.
criteria.card_not_working: Physical card generally not working / not functioning, without being about a specific declined payment, ATM, contactless or virtual card.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up / card used for top-up; verification code for a top-up; 3D secure for top-up.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Whether a particular currency (EUR, USD, etc.) is supported or allowed for holding or exchange, e.g. 'Are EUR exchanges allowed?', 'Are you able to make exchanges to EUR?'; which fiat currencies are supported.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to request a refund for a purchase; how to get a refund.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs the card works at; whether an ATM will take the card; finding an ATM; using ATMs abroad.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Customer sent/transferred money to another person, business or account (friend, son, landlord, retailer; 'the account number is right') and it has not arrived / is 'not here yet'.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed / keeps failing / did not go through / was returned (worded as failing rather than declined).
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money the customer transferred into their own account by bank transfer has not shown up in their balance; balance unchanged after a transfer. Includes transfers from their UK account: 'How long does a transfer from a UK account take? I made one and it isn't showing up', 'please check my UK account, I made the transfer a couple of hours ago'.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Charged a fee for paying by card; charged extra when using the card; complaints about a 'hidden fee', 'too many fees', 'some of my payments have fees', 'I'm tired of being charged fees, when do you charge fees?'.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into/top up the account from another bank account.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM declined the cash withdrawal; could not withdraw cash.
criteria.card_arrival: Customer ordered a card and it has not arrived yet; tracking a card in the post; card is late.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up feature: what it is, setting it up, turning it off, its limits or amounts.
criteria.declined_transfer: The customer's transfers are being declined or denied (the message says transfers are declined/denied, even if it also mentions a card purchase).
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer; fees for banking/sending money abroad or an increase in fees overseas; short vague questions like 'why was I charged?' or 'will I get extra charges?'.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee; trouble transferring money to a beneficiary; a transfer to an account/beneficiary 'wasn't allowed' / is not allowed.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal shows as pending.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes in general, delivery times to a country, express delivery; when to expect a card (asked before/without a delay).
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Customer tried to verify their identity and it failed, is not working or still shows unverified ('my app says I'm not verified'); they can't do it (rejected, error, app won't accept documents).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Customer deposited money, a cheque or cash and it hasn't shown in their balance; 'I deposited money but it isn't showing', 'when will my deposit show up?'.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money/payments from others; getting paid or receiving salary into the account (incl. 'do I need to add my salary?', being paid in a given currency).
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Charged a fee for an ATM cash withdrawal; withdrawal fees.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card was lost or stolen; customer wants help retrieving or finding their card.
